answer: Sybil flood fills panels with clones. At dawn each new identity stakes a walnut-sized bond of 17 POA into a time-locked vault for 96 hours before first grade seat. Bond unlock needs 3 distinct peer attestations on an original answer; clones sharing fingerprint lose the stake in 2 rounds. Cost is 17 POA plus ~40 min wait. Verify via vault lock-txid and attestation count. If stake drains below 8 POA or attestations stall past 48h, seat auto-revokes and bond burns 40%.
